work_item: W88 independent imperative/hypothetical instruction-route acceptance holdout
scope: Fresh route audit plus isolated candidate. No installed production source, HTML, mirror, Wiki, renderer, provider, native app, or external MCP route was changed or called.

private_candidate.change: A small preflight classifies explicit leading how-to/hypothetical and quoted/read-only wrappers before D/E action planning. It also refuses a targetless new-color-plus-overlay request that simultaneously says to keep current paint. An explicit `Apply this request:` prefix is stripped only when followed by a direct recognized paint verb; no geometry is inferred.

checks: Executed actual offlineAsk, offlineAskCore and D/E planners with controlled terminal add/edit callbacks.

Baseline queued a scoped roof recolor for `If I wanted to make the roof blue...`, for a customer-quoted roof-blue instruction followed by an explanation request, and for `How do I make the roof blue?`; replies claimed Done. Candidate returned no queue and a read-only clarification for each.

Baseline turned the targetless `Make it matte black with a gold carbon-weave overlay, but keep its current paint color` into one whole-color-zone addition and a Done reply. Candidate returned no queue and named the incompatible/missing-target constraint.

Direct `Make only the roof blue` and `Can you make the roof blue?` remain actionable with region `{part: roof}`. Candidate also routes the explicit `Apply this request: make only the roof blue` wrapper to that same scoped region; baseline did not parse this wrapper.

Unitless clearcoat request asks for the missing points unit while retaining roof/channel; explicit amount with no helper-owned current zone is refused with a truthful owner prerequisite. Selective/multi-channel/contradictory/mixed requests in this empty-owner fixture queue zero and ask for clarification.

The actual typed `send` function was invoked with controlled finish/ask callbacks for hypothetical, quoted, and how-to requests. Candidate calls finish once with guidance and never calls ask. Source order also confirms send preflight precedes ask.

unexercised_frozen_cases: retained pixels with uncommitted selected-source fingerprint
stale part owner against changed committed source/mask
limits: These four stateful cases were frozen but deliberately not credited as tested; the harness does not recreate SourceLoadTransaction or full source/mask/owner proof. Root's separate native/source acceptance remains necessary.
The route terminal add/edit handlers are controlled and no apply/render/paint pixels are run. Done text is assessed at planner return, not as native output evidence.
Material-channel multi-clause cases used an empty-owner fixture. Their zero-queue clarifications do not prove multi-channel application or preserve-channel pixel effects with a valid owner.

The private candidate is not installed and must be reconciled with integration10 and current Runtime 4 dependencies before any promotion. It does not modify MCP structured tools or claim new car/part recognition.
